+ submitFundTransfer(srcID: String, destID: String, amount: double, type: String) : Transaction
+ makeCardPayment(cardID: String, amount: double, merchantID: String) : Transaction
+ makeRepayment(loanID: String, amount: double, method: String) : void
+ record(userID: String, action: String, module: String, outcome: String) : void
